bio: In the charming Servitenviertel – an area replete with small shops, eateries and lovely period architecture – this lively and cosy establishment has a rustic feel. It is right next to the Servitenkirche, a Baroque church that is certainly worth a visit. The neighbourly atmosphere is as much of a draw as the delicious Austrian food. The menu features dishes such as pork crackling dumplings with coleslaw or mushroom goulash with bread dumplings, not to mention classics like Wiener schnitzel with potato and lamb's lettuce salad. The traditional Sunday roast naturally has its place as well. Tip: Mon-Fri, there is a reasonably priced lunch special. Tables on the tree-shaded garden terrace are coveted in summer....
